entry.title: Fastest time to limbo skate under descending poles over 50 m

media:group.media:title: Fastest time to limbo skate under descending poles over 50 m
media:group.media:description:
Fastest time to limbo skate under descending poles over 50 m 🛼 6.86 seconds by Shrishti Dharmendra Sharma 🇮🇳
Multiple limbo skating record holder Shrishti from India is an avid campaigner for the Save a Girl Child humanitarian project, and she uses her record attempts to promote the organization.
"Women must be empowered and given equal opportunities to demonstrate their abilities," says Shrishti. "Give her the right opportunity, and she will make her family and country proud through her achievements. Girls can achieve extraordinary things when they receive proper support, encouragement, and opportunities."
